facts.fact: 全章框架：罗马的夜里孩子们睡觉并做梦，叙述者带读者像鬼一样潜入民宅
facts.anchor: At night in Rome the children sleep, and they dream

facts.fact: Timoteo 住在城郊 Tor Bella Monaca，蜷在破毯子里，梦里去森林与村庄
facts.anchor: little Timoteo—a boy more tangled hair than puppy fat

facts.fact: Timoteo 的家人被某个东西灭掉，那东西此刻正一步步不慌不忙地逼近他
facts.anchor: His family has been wiped out by something, the same something that stalks him now

facts.fact: Giulia 每晚为覆盖半张脸的胎记哭泣，临睡前把那一侧脸埋进枕头
facts.anchor: the large, crumpled birthmark that covers half her face

facts.fact: 别的孩子叫她 Pretty，是反话
facts.anchor: The other children call her Pretty, because she isn’t and never will be

facts.fact: 梦中一条美人鱼吻了她的脸颊，胎记消失
facts.anchor: Then one brushes a kiss against her cheek

facts.fact: 胎记消失后美人鱼受惊逃散，把 Giulia 独自留在水里
facts.anchor: They dash away, abandoning her

facts.fact: 有东西从背后逼近 Giulia，叙述者说读者也不知道她会否转身
facts.anchor: Something is approaching from behind

facts.fact: Zivorad 是从没有过家的孩子，睡在台伯河桥下成堆的破布与垃圾里
facts.anchor: Zivorad, a child who has never had anything resembling a home

facts.fact: Zivorad 在血肉世界像个凶恶的侏儒，在梦里是站在食物堆前的小快乐东西
facts.anchor: in the world of flesh Zivorad looks like a malignant gnome

facts.fact: 戴手套的男人说不想伤害他，但他在说谎，叙述者点明 Zivorad 不知情
facts.anchor: The man is lying, but Zivorad doesn’t know that

facts.fact: 第一小节收束：这样的事就发生在罗马的夜里
facts.anchor: These things happen, on Roman nights

facts.fact: Wendy 二十五岁，已在主广场纳沃纳的木摊卖艺，是她最不想待的位置
facts.anchor: The Wondrous Wendy is in the last place

facts.fact: 时间是主显节前夜，按传统第二天是罗马节庆的高峰
facts.anchor: Tonight is the Eve of the Epiphany

facts.fact: Wendy 表演三个倒扣彩色玻璃杯的戏法，杯下各有一颗红色布球
facts.anchor: Under each one is a red fabric ball

facts.fact: Wendy 当众从嘲弄她的粉衣男耳朵里抽出一条红围巾回敬他
facts.anchor: she informs him

facts.fact: 那套戏法道具卖十五欧元，粉衣男的女友也吵着要买
facts.anchor: But for fifteen euros the kit is yours

facts.fact: Wendy 把街头卖艺比作十五欧元一次的卖身，艺给了不懂它的人
facts.anchor: It’s like getting fucked in the street for fifteen euros a pop

facts.fact: 她把手法摆成买卖，观众散场后独自抱紧大衣
facts.anchor: Sleight of hand for sale for everyone

facts.fact: PsyKlops 和 Wedge 骑摩托车拐进小巷去涂鸦
facts.anchor: PsyKlops and Wedge turn down a back street

facts.fact: 他们要写的是红底黄边的 Ganja Crew Rulez
facts.anchor: we’re writing Ganja Crew Rulez, in red on black

facts.fact: 地点是 San Basilio 区，与 Piazza Fiume 那种体面罗马完全不同
facts.anchor: This is the Rome of San Basilio district

facts.fact: 一个五岁不到、棕色皮肤卷发的孩子现身制止他们用颜料
facts.anchor: It’s a tiny boy who can’t be more than five years old

facts.fact: 那孩子只穿工装裤与不成对的袜子，一只是绿色、另一只印着一只眼的维尼熊
facts.anchor: one green, the other displaying a one-eyed Winnie the Pooh

facts.fact: 第三个男孩瘦小得几乎站不住，眼镜框缠着胶带，挥着一把锡剑
facts.anchor: He brandishes a tin sword

facts.fact: 孩子们直说自己要来伤害他们，语气毫无威胁姿态
facts.anchor: We intend to hurt you

facts.fact: 孩子陆续从暗处出现，最后九个围成半圆
facts.anchor: Six become seven, and then eight, then nine

facts.fact: PsyKlops 和 Wedge 真名是 Giulio 和 Luca，父亲分别是建筑师和罗马顶级商业顾问之一
facts.anchor: sons respectively of an architect and one of Rome’s leading business consultants

facts.fact: 结尾预告：Giulio 被杀死剥皮，Luca 背被打断、一只耳朵被扯下
facts.anchor: when Giulio is dead and skinned, and Luca’s back is broken

facts.fact: 一个比孩子们略高、不穿鞋的身影蹲到 Luca 耳边
facts.anchor: It wears no shoes

facts.fact: 那身影带薄荷与海水的气味，只留下一句话：告诉他们，他回来了
facts.anchor: Tell them he’s coming back
